en: A black and white postcard depicting a rustic wooden house surrounded by pine trees and rocky terrain. The house features classic Scandinavian architecture with shuttered windows and a small porch. There is an open seating area with tables and benches outside. The photo is likely taken on a hill or elevated area, as suggested by the landscape. The words 'Gillestugan, Södra Stadsberget, Sundsvall.' are printed at the bottom.
